title: Decision: public Hub::hub_sender returns the ExternalSender encoding
description: Audit item 11. room::hub_sender (hub/room.rs:60, pub(super)) builds the TLS SignaturePublicKey + BasicCredential that concatenated form the hub's ExternalSender (RFC 9420 §12.1.8.1); the only public accessor, Hub::signature_public_key (hub/mod.rs:218), returns the raw 32 bytes. The account capability's hubSender must be the ExternalSender encoding. Chosen (Mark, 2026-10-18): add pub Hub::hub_sender() returning the concatenated bytes via the existing builder; hubSender = base64url of it.
